description: Subscribe a monitor to a SPECIFIC named credit union's published rate and alert via webhook when that CU changes its rate (vs the aggregate market-best decision). Returns the monitor with a webhook_signing_secret (shown once) and a baseline snapshot of the CU's current rate.

audience.description: Scope offers by WHO they are for: 'business' returns business-audience products (DSCR mortgages, commercial vehicle loans, SBA); 'consumer' excludes them. Omit for both.

conditions.description: Alert conditions on the named CU rate. Default: any change.

min_change_bps.description: Min basis-point move to alert. Default 0.

occupancy.description: MORTGAGE/HELOC: property occupancy. 'investment' returns investor / non-owner-occupied / DSCR pricing; 'secondary' second-home pricing. Omit for standard primary-residence offers.

state.description: 2-letter state for the CU published rate.

target_credit_union.description: The specific credit union whose published rate to watch. Required.

name.description: Optional human label / lookup by name.

name: create_competitor_monitor

outputSchema.description: Result of creating a competitor-watch monitor targeting one named credit union.

disclosures.description: Scope caveats about what this monitor does and does not alert on.

important.description: Warning that the signing secret is shown only once.

current_rate.description: The competitor's rate at creation time, the baseline for future comparisons.

as_of.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the baseline rate.

webhook_signing_secret_prefix.description: Non-secret prefix of the signing secret, for identifying it later.

webhook_url.description: URL that fires on a trigger.

summary.description: One-line confirmation naming the monitor and the credit union it watches.

webhook_signing_secret.description: Full HMAC signing secret. Shown once, at creation.
